description: PROTOTYPE (QA #42, A5). Qwen Code (>=0.24) hooks for the Crosstalk bus. Merge the `hooks` object into ~/.qwen/settings.json on an ENROLLED machine and replace <plugin-src> with the installed plugin's src dir. Same protocol as Claude Code hooks: stdin JSON with session_id, exit 2 blocks. `timeout` is in SECONDS. User-level hooks need no trust prompt but are read only at session start. The receive bridge needs the session to run under `qwen serve` (QWEN_SERVE_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:4170). SECURITY — NOT PRODUCTION-READY: bus text reaches an agent that can run tools. The run_shell_command hook below (cc-qwen-shell-gate.mjs) is defence in depth for POSIX sh only and has KNOWN BYPASSES (flag injection such as --base, cmd.exe / PowerShell quoting, identity spoofing; other tools are not gated; fail-open on hook crash is unmeasured) — see the STATUS block at the top of that file. Use on scratch profiles for QA only until the typed-MCP-tool design replaces it.
